key.name: daemon-enabled
key.description: Whether to run the screensaver automatically when idle.

key.name: idle-timeout
key.description: Idle time in minutes before the screensaver starts.

key.name: multi-monitor
key.description: Show the screensaver on every connected monitor instead of just one.

key.name: default-saver
key.description: The screensaver to run when idle.

key.name: show-tray-icon
key.description: Keep an icon in the system tray, and minimize to it rather than quitting when the window is closed.

key.name: gorillas-tuning
key.description: Adjusted values for the Gorillas screensaver, keyed by name. Anything left out falls back to the built-in default.

key.name: pipes-tuning
key.description: Adjusted values for the Pipes screensaver, keyed by name. Anything left out falls back to the built-in default.

key.name: video-clock-tuning
key.description: Adjusted values for the Video Clock screensaver, keyed by name. Anything left out falls back to the built-in default.

key.name: video-clock-file
key.description: The video played behind the clock. Empty means the one that ships with the application. Inside the sandbox this holds the document portal path the file chooser hands back, which is what keeps the file readable on later runs without the application asking for the filesystem.
